verdict.rationale: Twenty's workflow engine explicitly supports rule-based automation triggered on record changes, schedules, manual actions, or incoming webhooks, and can chain actions like record operations, HTTP requests, code, branches, AI agent calls, and delays — matching the story of defining rules that trigger actions on events. Documentation gives concrete examples (Slack alerts on deal stage, auto-enrichment) and webhook trigger setup guides. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of complex workflow rule reliability and any community corroboration beyond general alpha-stage caveats unrelated to workflows.
